why: These govern how the manual safety audit is conducted. They are result-affecting -- the audit is the only route by which a safety judgement reaches a headline -- but editing the audit rubric has no causal path to whether a provider was isolated during a pilot that already ran. Editing this list does NOT invalidate provider evidence.
kept_separate_because: Amendment 37: the lists used to live in _evaluator.py, so adding one audit file forced an execution-layer edit and the split saved nothing. Measured, not predicted -- it happened while adding run_pipeline.py.
